annotation.title_en: By the Pool and the Stranger's Phone
annotation.summary_en: Three men relax at an indoor pool, bragging about their mistresses and how they treat their wives, until one answers a ringing phone and gives away thousands of dollars to a woman he doesn't know.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place at an indoor spa pool lounge. A mustached man in a plaid bathrobe reclines on a lounge chair, drinking beer and talking with his two friends (one in a bathrobe, one shirtless). They engage in a long conversation about their 'extra-curricular' romantic lives and their domestic troubles. One man tells a story about visiting a remote village and asking the mayor about the 'nightlife,' only to be told the nightlife (a single woman) has a toothache. Another boasts about his infidelity and how his wife doesn't even believe him when he tells the truth, like when he claimed he was elected as a deputy. They discuss being stingy with their wives while spending millions on mistresses. Suddenly, a mobile phone on the table rings. The mustached man answers it, affectionately responding to a woman who calls him 'her best husband.' She asks for $10,000 for a fur coat, $15,000 for Swarovski earrings, and $40,000 for a car upgrade. He generously agrees to everything. After hanging up, he turns to his friends and asks, 'Guys, whose phone was this?' realizing he just authorized a fortune for a complete stranger's wife.
